deduplication_rules.unresolved_equivalence: EQUIVALENCE_UNSUPPORTED unless certified by the existing engine

legality_rules.statement: local_U1_connection requires a field-content option that includes A_mu
a field-content option that includes A_mu requires local_U1_connection
Maxwell_F2 requires local_U1_connection
bounded_higher_derivative_gauge_term requires local_U1_connection
bounded_higher_derivative_gauge_term requires second_derivative
no_gauge and global_U1 require gauge dynamics absent
real_scalar field content uses INTERNAL_SPACE R1
real_internal_vector field content uses INTERNAL_SPACE R2 or R3
complex_scalar field content uses INTERNAL_SPACE R1 as C
real_U1 requires a real internal vector and INTERNAL_SPACE R2 or R3
real_U1_1plus2 requires a real internal vector and INTERNAL_SPACE R3
complex_U1_character requires complex_scalar field content and R1
commutant_symmetric and polynomial_in_KT_K require a representation with K
projector_decomposition and identity_plus_projector require INTERNAL_SPACE dimension >= 2
any curvature coupling other than none requires generally_covariant spacetime
gauge_matter_minimal, matter_gauge, and internal_gauge require local_U1_connection
internal_gauge requires a real internal vector
scalar_curvature and curvature_matter_coupling require curvature coupling other than none
mixed_internal_kinetic requires a real internal vector
scalar_scalar_cross_term requires INTERNAL_SPACE dimension >= 2
SO2 and finite_combination_of_declared_symmetries require a representation with K
SO3 requires a real internal vector and INTERNAL_SPACE R3
discrete_reflection and finite_combination_of_declared_symmetries require DISCRETE_SYMMETRY other than none
internal_reflection requires INTERNAL_SPACE dimension >= 2
parity_odd is illegal because no epsilon-tensor operator is a declared option
dynamical_modulus uses the existing Phi; it does not add a field
MINIMALITY_LEVEL=minimal is the declared restricted slice; it is not a ranking filter applied after generation
conformal-specific structures are not implicitly inserted

CROSS_SECTOR_COUPLING.bounded_cross_sector_basis: finite union of {matter_gravity, matter_gauge} when both are structurally available; no arbitrary graphs
CROSS_SECTOR_COUPLING.internal_gauge: internal operator couples through the connection; requires local_U1_connection and an internal vector
CROSS_SECTOR_COUPLING.matter_gauge: matter current couples to A_mu; requires local_U1_connection
CROSS_SECTOR_COUPLING.matter_gravity: matter stress couples to the dynamical metric; requires generally_covariant
CROSS_SECTOR_COUPLING.none: no additional cross-sector operator beyond sector-local terms
CROSS_SECTOR_COUPLING.scalar_curvature: scalar-curvature cross term; requires a declared curvature coupling

CURVATURE_COUPLING.bounded_nonminimal_basis: finite basis {R |Phi|^2, R X} with two symbolic coefficients; no arbitrary f(R,Phi)
CURVATURE_COUPLING.minimal_scalar: Phi coupled to g_mu_nu only through the covariant volume and index contraction; no Phi^2 R term
CURVATURE_COUPLING.scalar_curvature_linear: xi R |Phi|^2 with xi symbolic; not a silently inserted conformal value

DERIVATIVE_ORDER.first_derivative: matter and gauge operators use at most one spacetime derivative per field factor
DERIVATIVE_ORDER.second_derivative: declared second-derivative basis allowed: Ricci (when covariant) and D F (when the higher-derivative gauge option is selected); no further operators

DISCRETE_SYMMETRY.internal_reflection: declared involution R on the internal space, R^2=I, R!=I; requires internal dimension >= 2

FIELD_CONTENT.complex_scalar: complex scalar field Phi: M -> C
FIELD_CONTENT.complex_scalar_plus_connection: complex scalar Phi together with abelian connection A_mu
FIELD_CONTENT.real_internal_vector: real internal vector Phi: M -> R^n with n = dim(internal_space)
FIELD_CONTENT.real_internal_vector_plus_connection: real internal vector Phi together with abelian connection A_mu
FIELD_CONTENT.real_scalar: real scalar field Phi: M -> R
FIELD_CONTENT.real_scalar_plus_connection: real scalar Phi together with abelian connection A_mu

GAUGE_DYNAMICS.Maxwell_F2: L_A = -Z_A/4 F_mu_nu F^{mu nu}; Z_A conventional; F = dA
GAUGE_DYNAMICS.bounded_higher_derivative_gauge_term: L_A contains c_DF (D_alpha F_mu_nu)(D^alpha F^{mu nu}) with c_DF symbolic; finite operator, not a black box

GAUGE_STRUCTURE.global_U1: global U(1)/SO(2) acting by the declared representation; no connection
GAUGE_STRUCTURE.local_U1_connection: local U(1) with abelian connection A_mu

INTERACTION_STRUCTURE.curvature_matter_coupling: matter-curvature interaction present; requires a declared curvature coupling and generally_covariant spacetime
INTERACTION_STRUCTURE.gauge_matter_minimal: minimal substitution D_mu = partial_mu - A_mu K on the declared representation; requires local_U1_connection
INTERACTION_STRUCTURE.internal_operator_coupling: c_H inner(Phi, H_int Phi) with c_H symbolic
INTERACTION_STRUCTURE.internal_self_interaction: the declared internal operator already supplies inner(Phi, H Phi); this class selects that coupling as present
INTERACTION_STRUCTURE.none: no additional interaction beyond kinetic, potential, and declared operator coupling
INTERACTION_STRUCTURE.scalar_scalar_cross_term: additional symbolic bilinear between independent real components when the internal space has dimension >= 2

INTERNAL_OPERATOR.bounded_polynomial_operator: H = b0 I + b1 M + b2 M^2 for a declared matrix M, polynomial degree at most 2
INTERNAL_OPERATOR.commutant_symmetric: real symmetric H with [K,H]=0; independent coefficients determined by the commutant
INTERNAL_OPERATOR.diagonal_generic: H diagonal in a declared ONB; one symbolic eigenvalue per internal axis
INTERNAL_OPERATOR.identity_plus_projector: H = a0 I + a1 P for a declared projector P
INTERNAL_OPERATOR.polynomial_in_KT_K: H = a0 I + a1 (K^T K) with polynomial degree at most 1 in K^T K
INTERNAL_OPERATOR.projector_decomposition: H = a0 P + a1 (I-P) for a declared projector P, P^2=P, P^*=P

INTERNAL_SPACE.R1: real line R^1 as internal target/Hilbert fibre
INTERNAL_SPACE.R2: real plane R^2 as internal target/Hilbert fibre
INTERNAL_SPACE.R3: real space R^3 as internal target/Hilbert fibre

KINETIC_STRUCTURE.canonical_quadratic: L_kin = Z g^{mu nu} inner(D_mu Phi, D_nu Phi); Z conventional
KINETIC_STRUCTURE.derivative_coupling: additional first-derivative mixing inner(Phi, D_mu Phi) inner(Phi, D^mu Phi) with one symbolic coefficient
KINETIC_STRUCTURE.field_dependent_quadratic: L_kin = (z0 + z1 |Phi|^2) g^{mu nu} inner(D_mu Phi, D_nu Phi); degree at most 1 in |Phi|^2
KINETIC_STRUCTURE.k_essence_polynomial: same finite polynomial basis in X as nonlinear_X; retained as an explicit class, not an arbitrary F(X)
KINETIC_STRUCTURE.mixed_internal_kinetic: L_kin = (w0 delta_ij + w1 Phi_i Phi_j) g^{mu nu} (D_mu Phi)^i (D_nu Phi)^j; requires internal vector
KINETIC_STRUCTURE.nonlinear_X: L_kin = a1 X + a2 X^2 with X = g^{mu nu} inner(D_mu Phi, D_nu Phi); degree at most 2

MINIMALITY_LEVEL.extended_but_bounded: any combination allowed by the other axes and legality rules; not a ranking label
MINIMALITY_LEVEL.minimal: canonical_quadratic kinetic, V2 potential, interaction none, curvature none, cross-sector none, first_derivative, gauge dynamics absent or Maxwell_F2, parity_even, discrete none, modulus fixed_parameters

MODULUS_STRUCTURE.dynamical_modulus: one existing |Phi|^2 polynomial of degree at most 1 multiplies a declared coefficient; no new field, no hidden dilaton, no hidden compensator
MODULUS_STRUCTURE.fixed_parameters: all coefficients are constants, not fields

PARITY_STRUCTURE.parity_even: all declared operators are even under x -> -x without an epsilon tensor
PARITY_STRUCTURE.parity_odd: would require a declared epsilon-tensor operator; this grammar does not include that operator

POTENTIAL_STRUCTURE.V2_plus_V4: V = kappa |Phi|^2 + lambda4 |Phi|^4; both coefficients symbolic
POTENTIAL_STRUCTURE.V4: V = lambda4 |Phi|^4; lambda4 symbolic; no target minimum

REPRESENTATION.complex_U1_character: complex U(1) character on C; charge weight symbolic, not a measured fraction
REPRESENTATION.real_U1: real so(2) generator K with K^T=-K acting on R^n, n>=2; weights remain symbolic
REPRESENTATION.real_U1_1plus2: real so(2) generator on R^3 = R oplus R^2; weights remain symbolic
REPRESENTATION.trivial: trivial representation; no internal generator K

SPACETIME_STRUCTURE.flat_minkowski: fixed Minkowski background eta_mu_nu; no dynamical metric
SPACETIME_STRUCTURE.generally_covariant: generally covariant 4D Lorentzian metric g_mu_nu; gravity family remains integral sqrt(-g)(c0 + c1 R) with c0,c1 FREE

SYMMETRY_CLASS.SO2: claimed global SO(2); must later be tested on the full action
SYMMETRY_CLASS.SO3: claimed SO(3) on R^3; must later be tested on the full action
SYMMETRY_CLASS.discrete_reflection: claimed discrete reflection; requires a declared discrete option
SYMMETRY_CLASS.finite_combination_of_declared_symmetrie: claimed SO(2) together with a declared discrete option; not inferred from degeneracy
SYMMETRY_CLASS.none: no claimed internal continuous symmetry; any claim must later be tested on the full action

parameter_schema_policy.conventional_parameters: normalizations such as Z and Z_A
parameter_schema_policy.reparameterizations: overall kinetic scale when it is an alias
